 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Psephallogy'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Psephology'.**
 
• The word '**Psephology**' is a **noun** which refers to the statistical study of elections and trends in voting. **(चुनाव विश्लेषण)**
 
• **Etymology:** It is derived from the Greek word *psephos*, meaning 'pebble' (which the Greeks used as ballots).
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• Experts in **psephology** were invited to the news channel to predict the outcome of the general elections.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Psephallogy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Pedagogy -** the method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept **(शिक्षाशास्त्र)**
 
• **Psephology - **(As defined above) the study of how people vote in elections **(चुनाव विश्लेषण)**
 
• **Hagiography -** the writing of the lives of saints, or a biography that idealizes its subject **(संत-चरित / अति-प्रशंसात्मक जीवनी)**
